extra.description: Turn a video idea into a brief with timed action, reference roles, shot prompts and a production handoff.

descriptions.channel-audit: Take stock of a channel before changing anything: its usual numbers, its weak step, and what cannot be seen.
descriptions.channel-setup: Onboard a channel in seven ordered steps, from checking what the agent can reach to proving one piece end to end.
descriptions.content-plan: Turn a strategy into a rolling two-to-four-week plan in which every slot is a recorded bet.
descriptions.find-the-angle: Find the fresh, true thing to say about a subject before making anything.
descriptions.find-what-works: Study other accounts' unusual hits, with links and numbers, to find what to model pieces on.
descriptions.niche-research: Size up a channel idea before committing: the audience, who serves it, the gap, the cost and the odds.
descriptions.strategy: Turn an audit and a study of proven posts into one to three bets with targets, stop rules and a format sheet.
descriptions.cut-shorts-from-long-video: Find the moments in a long video that can stand alone as short videos.
descriptions.hook: Write the opening line or first second that makes someone stay.
descriptions.make-image: Make still images with an AI image tool, and check them properly.
descriptions.make-narrated-video: Cut a narrated video from still images, voice, captions and sound.
descriptions.model-a-proven-post: Start from a post that already worked for a comparable account, keep what made it work, change the rest, and show the two side by side.
descriptions.packaging: Make the title, cover image and caption that decide whether a piece gets opened.
descriptions.script-short-video: Write a short video beat by beat, so it works with the sound off.
descriptions.write-post: Write a text or image post that is worth a stranger's time.
descriptions.fact-check: Check the few claims a piece stands on against their original sources.
descriptions.fresh-eyes-check: Get a second look from someone who did not make the piece, with a verdict that can be "dull".
descriptions.reply-to-comments: Answer real comments on a channel's own posts, and leave the rest alone.
descriptions.ship-and-verify: Publish or schedule a piece, then prove that what went live is what was made.
descriptions.measure: Read a post's numbers at the right age and record them honestly.
descriptions.paid-test: Spend a small ads budget as an experiment with a stop rule.
descriptions.weekly-review: Close the week: read the results, update what works, rewrite the strategy, tell the owner.
